name: aetheris-omni
description: Aetheris Omni — an online-first AI platform with exactly five product areas: Chat, Image, Video, Plugins, MCP

scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:web && npm run test:fabric
scripts.train: cd services/fabric && ${AETHERIS_PYTHON:-python3} -c "from fabric.pipeline import Pipeline, PipelineConfig; r = Pipeline(PipelineConfig(epochs=25)).run(); print(r.status, r.run_id)"
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run web:build

//: This is a script runner, not an npm workspace, on purpose.
services/core has ZERO npm dependencies (Node standard library only, including
node:sqlite, hence engines.node >= 22.5.0). services/fabric is Python and needs
only NumPy. apps/web is the single component with a dependency tree, and it
Hoisting those into a root workspace would give the core service and the
training service a dependency tree they do not have and do not want, and would
make the zero-dependency property of services/core untestable. Each component
is installed and tested independently; `npm test` runs all three suites.
Python tests need an interpreter with numpy and pytest. They do not need torch,
and installing torch here is actively harmful: on a GPU-less host pip pulls the

Python scripts honour $AETHERIS_PYTHON (default: python3). Set it when numpy and pytest live in a virtualenv rather than on the system interpreter — e.g. AETHERIS_PYTHON=/path/to/venv/bin/python npm run test:fabric. Do not install torch to satisfy them; nothing here needs it.

Training is a library call or an HTTP POST to the Fabric service, not a CLI: fabric/run.py is the RunRecord module. `npm run train` runs the pipeline in-process; `npm run fabric:run` triggers it through the service (start `npm run fabric` first).

Aetheris Lite training is a pure-NumPy from-scratch language model: `npm run lm:train` runs the release configuration and `npm run lm:quick` a 60-step smoke run. No torch, no GPU, no downloads. Artifacts go to services/fabric/artifacts/, which is gitignored by policy: weights are referenced by digest from a model card, never redistributed through this repository.
